pages.title: Market Sentiment Analysis
pages.text: /* Global Layout */ #sidebar, #secondary, .widget-area { display: none !important; } #main { width: 100% !important; float: none !important; margin: 0 auto !important; } .container { max-width: 1600px !important; width: 98% !important; } .sentiment-wrapper { text-align: center; padding: 25px; background: #fdfdfd; border-radius: 15px; font-family: sans-serif; } /* Stats Row Cards */ .stats-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 25px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .stat-card { flex: 1; min-width: 250px; background: #ffffff; padding: 20px; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; padding-left: 30px; } .stat-info { text-align: left; margin-left: 20px; } .stat-title { font-size: 15px; color: #666; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px; } .stat-value { font-size: 26px; color: #26a69a; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .stat-icon { width: 45px; height: 45px; object-fit: contain; flex-shrink: 0; } /* Tabs & Charts */ .time-tabs { margin: 0 auto 30px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .tab-btn { padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #eeeeee; background-color: #ffffff !important; color: #444444 !important; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.3s; } .tab-btn.active { background-color: #26a69a !important; color: #ffffff !important; border-color: #26a69a; } .chart-container { display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; flex-wrap: nowrap !important; gap: 20px; width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 10px; } .chart-box { flex: 1; min-width: 450px; height: 500px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; } .fng-container { width: 100%; margin-top: 30px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #f2f2f2; } BTC Dominance-- % ETH Dominance-- % Altcoin Index-- / 100 Live 1 Min 15 Min 1 Hour 1 Day 1 Week 1 Month (function() { let btcWs, ethWs, charts = {}; const syms = ['BTCUSDT', 'ETHUSDT']; // 1. Update Global Market Cap Stats async function updateCryptoStats() { try { const res = await fetch('https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/global'); const json = await res.json(); const data = json.data; const btcDom = data.market_cap_percentage.btc.toFixed(1); const ethDom = data.market_cap_percentage.eth.toFixed(1); document.getElementById('btc-dom').innerText = btcDom + '%'; document.getElementById('eth-dom').innerText = ethDom + '%'; document.getElementById('alt-index').innerText = (100 - parseFloat(btcDom)).toFixed(0) + ' / 100'; } catch (e) { console.error("CG API Error", e); } } // 2. Chart Options Helper function getPieOpt(s, n) { return { title: { text: s + ' In/Out Flow (' + n + ')', left: 'center', top: '2%', textStyle: { fontSize: 18 } }, tooltip: { trigger: 'item', formatter: '{b}: {c} ({d}%)' }, legend: { bottom: '5%', icon: 'circle' }, series: [{ type: 'pie', radius: ['35%', '55%'], center: ['50%', '48%'], itemStyle: { borderRadius: 8, borderColor: '#fff', borderWidth: 2 }, label: { show: true, formatter: '{b}\n{d}%' }, data: [{value:0, name:'Inflow'}, {value:0, name:'Outflow'}] }] }; } // 3. Update Pie Charts (WebSocket for Live, Binance API for intervals) async function updateCharts(p) { if (btcWs) btcWs.close(); if (ethWs) ethWs.close(); for (const s of syms) { const c = charts[s]; if (p === 'live') { let b=0, se=0; const ws = new WebSocket(`wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/${s.toLowerCase()}@trade`); if (s === 'BTCUSDT') btcWs = ws; else ethWs = ws; ws.onmessage = (e) => { const d = JSON.parse(e.data); d.m ? se += parseFloat(d.q) : b += parseFloat(d.q); c.setOption({series:[{data:[ {value:b.toFixed(3), name:'Inflow', itemStyle:{color:'#26a69a'}}, {value:se.toFixed(3), name:'Outflow', itemStyle:{color:'#ef5350'}} ]}]}); }; c.setOption(getPieOpt(s, 'Live')); } else { try { const res = await fetch(`https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=${s}&interval=${p}&limit=1`); const data = await res.json(); c.setOption(getPieOpt(s, p.toUpperCase())); const buy = parseFloat(data[0][9]), total = parseFloat(data[0][5]); c.setOption({series:[{data:[ {value:buy.toFixed(2), name:'Inflow', itemStyle:{color:'#26a69a'}}, {value:(total-buy).toFixed(2), name:'Outflow', itemStyle:{color:'#ef5350'}} ]}]}); } catch(e) { console.error(e); } } } } // 4. Update Fear & Greed Gauge async function updateFnG() { try { const res = await fetch('https://api.alternative.me/fng/'); const json = await res.json(); const val = parseInt(json.data[0].value); const label = json.data[0].value_classification; const fngChart = echarts.init(document.getElementById('fng-chart')); fngChart.setOption({ title: { text: 'Crypto Fear & Greed Index', left: 'center', top: '5%' }, series: [{ type: 'gauge', center: ['50%', '60%'], startAngle: 200, endAngle: -20, min: 0, max: 100, axisLine: { lineStyle: { width: 25, color: [[0.25, '#ef5350'], [0.5, '#ffa726'], [0.75, '#ffee58'], [1, '#26a69a']] } }, progress: { show: true, width: 25 }, detail: { valueAnimation: true, formatter: val + '\n' + label, offsetCenter: [0, '35%'], fontSize: 30 }, data: [{ value: val }] }] }); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } // Initialize window.addEventListener('load', () => { syms.forEach(s => { charts[s] = echarts.init(document.getElementById(s === 'BTCUSDT' ? 'btc-chart' : 'eth-chart')); }); document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => { btn.onclick = function() { document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); this.classList.add('active'); updateCharts(this.dataset.p); }; }); updateCharts('1m'); updateFnG(); updateCryptoStats(); window.onresize = () => { Object.values(charts).forEach(c => c.resize()); const fng = echarts.getInstanceByDom(document.getElementById('fng-chart')); if(fng) fng.resize(); }; }); })();
